items.name: .NET
items.description: Cross-platform developer platform from Microsoft used to build web, desktop, mobile, cloud, and IoT applications across multiple programming languages.

items.name: .NET Core
items.description: Cross-platform, open-source implementation of .NET that ran on Windows, Linux, and macOS before being unified into the modern .NET platform.

items.name: .NET Framework
items.description: Original Windows-only implementation of .NET, providing a runtime and class libraries for building desktop and web applications on Windows.

items.name: .NET Standard
items.description: Specification defining a common set of APIs that different .NET implementations must support, enabling code and libraries to be shared across them.

items.name: Akka
items.description: Toolkit for building concurrent, distributed, and fault-tolerant applications on the JVM using the actor model for message-driven processing.

items.name: Apache CXF
items.description: Open-source Java framework for building and consuming web services, supporting both SOAP-based and RESTful service styles.

items.name: Apache Tomcat
items.description: Open-source Java servlet container that implements core Java EE web specifications, used to deploy and run Java web applications.

items.name: ASP.NET
items.description: Web application framework from Microsoft for building dynamic websites, services, and APIs on the .NET platform.

items.name: ASP.NET Core
items.description: Cross-platform, open-source web framework from Microsoft, succeeding ASP.NET, used to build web apps, APIs, and microservices on modern .NET.

items.name: ASP.NET Web Forms
items.description: Component of the original ASP.NET framework for building web applications using event-driven, server-side UI controls similar to desktop application development.

items.name: AutoMapper
items.description: Library for .NET that automates the mapping of properties between objects, commonly used to convert between domain models and data transfer objects.

items.name: Castle Windsor
items.description: Inversion of control container for .NET applications, used to manage object creation and dependency injection.

items.name: Dapper
items.description: Lightweight object-relational mapper for .NET that extends ADO.NET to map SQL query results to objects with minimal overhead.

items.name: Django
items.description: High-level Python web framework that follows the model-view-template pattern, designed for rapid development of secure, maintainable websites.

items.name: Drupal
items.description: Open-source content management system written in PHP, used to build, manage, and publish content-driven websites and web applications.

items.name: Eclipse Jetty
items.description: Lightweight, embeddable Java HTTP server and servlet container, often used to power web applications and services within larger Java programs.

items.name: EJS
items.description: Templating engine for JavaScript that generates HTML markup by embedding plain JavaScript code, commonly used with Node.js web applications.

items.name: Entity Framework
items.description: Object-relational mapping framework for .NET that lets developers interact with databases using .NET objects instead of writing raw SQL.

items.name: Express
items.description: Minimalist web application framework for Node.js that provides routing, middleware, and HTTP utilities for building web servers and APIs.

items.name: Express.js
items.description: Minimalist web application framework for Node.js that provides routing, middleware, and HTTP utilities for building web servers and APIs.

items.name: Flask
items.description: Lightweight Python web framework that offers routing and templating basics while leaving other components like databases up to the developer.

items.name: GraphQL
items.description: Query language and runtime for APIs that lets clients request exactly the data fields they need from a server in a single call.

items.name: gRPC
items.description: Open-source remote procedure call framework that uses protocol buffers for efficient, strongly-typed communication between services, often across languages.

items.name: JBoss (WildFly)
items.description: Java EE / Jakarta EE application server used to deploy and run enterprise Java applications, handling services like transactions, security, and messaging.

items.name: JSON Server
items.description: Command-line tool that spins up a full fake REST API from a JSON file, useful for prototyping frontends without a real backend.

items.name: Laravel
items.description: PHP web application framework that provides tools for routing, ORM, templating, and authentication to build web applications following the MVC pattern.

items.name: LINQ
items.description: Language-integrated query feature in .NET that lets developers write set-based queries over collections, databases, and XML directly in C# or VB.NET syntax.

items.name: MediatR
items.description: .NET library implementing the mediator pattern, used to decouple in-process request/response handling and event notifications between components.

items.name: Microsoft Graph API
items.description: Unified REST API and SDK that lets applications access data and services across Microsoft 365, such as Outlook, Teams, and Azure Active Directory.

items.name: Moshi
items.description: JSON serialization library for Java and Kotlin (commonly used on Android) that converts objects to and from JSON with reflection or generated adapters.

items.name: NestJS
items.description: TypeScript-based Node.js framework for building scalable server-side applications, providing a modular architecture inspired by Angular along with dependency injection.

items.name: NHibernate
items.description: Object-relational mapping framework for .NET that maps classes to relational database tables, handling data persistence and querying.

items.name: Node.js
items.description: JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine that enables running JavaScript outside the browser, commonly used to build servers and command-line tools.

items.name: Quarkus
items.description: Java framework optimized for building cloud-native, containerized applications with fast startup times and low memory footprint, often used with Kubernetes.

items.name: Razor
items.description: Markup syntax used in ASP.NET Core for embedding server-side C# code within HTML to generate dynamic web page views.

items.name: Retrofit
items.description: Type-safe HTTP client library for Java and Android that turns REST API endpoints into simple Java interface method calls.

items.name: Ruby on Rails
items.description: Web application framework written in Ruby that follows the MVC pattern and convention-over-configuration principles to speed up building database-backed web apps.

items.name: Socket.IO
items.description: JavaScript library that enables real-time, bidirectional communication between web clients and servers, built on top of WebSockets with fallback support.

items.name: Spring Boot
items.description: Java framework that simplifies building standalone, production-ready Spring applications by providing auto-configuration and embedded servers, reducing boilerplate setup.

items.name: Spring Data
items.description: Part of the Spring ecosystem that simplifies data access, offering consistent, repository-based abstractions for working with relational and NoSQL databases.

items.name: Spring MVC
items.description: Web framework within Spring for building server-side Java web applications and REST APIs using the model-view-controller pattern.

items.name: Spring WebFlux
items.description: Reactive web framework within Spring for building non-blocking, asynchronous web applications and APIs on top of reactive streams.

items.name: Unity Container
items.description: Lightweight dependency injection container for .NET applications that helps manage object creation and lifetime to support loosely coupled designs.

items.name: Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)
items.description: .NET framework for building service-oriented applications, enabling communication between distributed systems using configurable protocols and bindings.

items.name: WordPress
items.description: Open-source content management system used to build and manage websites and blogs, extensible through plugins and themes.
